targets.rawSql: SELECT wait_type, sum(wait_time_ms) AS total_wait_ms FROM sqlserver_monitoring.metrics_wait_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY wait_type ORDER BY total_wait_ms DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT created_at, session_id, blocking_session_id, database_name, wait_type, wait_time_ms, total_elapsed_time_ms, query_text FROM sqlserver_monitoring.metrics_active_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY total_elapsed_time_ms DESC LIMIT 50
